title: leiden
description:
Cluster cells using the Leiden algorithm, the GPU-accelerated
rapids-singlecell implementation built on cuGraph. Leiden is an improved
version of the Louvain algorithm. Requires a precomputed neighbor graph
(e.g. from the `find_neighbors` component).

modality.description: Which modality from the input MuData file to process.

obsp_connectivities.description: In which .obsp slot the neighbor connectivities can be found.

obsm_name.description:
Name of the .obsm key under which to add the cluster labels.
The name of the columns in the matrix will correspond to the
resolutions.

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata
objects

resolution.description:
A parameter value controlling the coarseness of the clustering.
Higher values lead to more clusters

n_iterations.description: Maximum number of iterations/levels of the Leiden algorithm

theta.description:
Scales modularity gain in the Leiden refinement phase, used to
compute the probability of joining a random Leiden community.

random_state.description: Random seed to initialise the optimization

use_weights.description:
If true, edge weights from the graph are used in the computation
(placing more emphasis on stronger edges).

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
